boundary_definition: Printed p. 18, left column, within LA PEDAGOGIA MODERNA: fix the two contiguous paragraphs beginning with the prescription that each educator develop harmoniously all physical, intellectual, ethical and aesthetic faculties of the learners and continuing through the paragraph directing each educator to guide activity by criterion and conscience and to cultivate the faculties rationally. Stop before the following paragraph on physiological and psychological laws.
preparation_note: Direct inspection of the exact HNDM primary page fixes an explicit pedagogical prescription in Enrique C. Rebsamen's La Pedagogia Moderna. The bounded unit directs the educator to develop the learner's physical, intellectual, ethical and aesthetic faculties harmoniously and frames guidance by criterion and conscience. The next paragraph on physiological and psychological laws is excluded. No source text or image is committed.

boundary_definition: Printed p. 17, left column, after the closing signature/date line of official Circular numero 53 and before DE FONDO: fix the two editorial paragraphs beginning with La Redaccion de La Escuela Moderna and ending with the notice that the Reglamento for the Congreso, then under study by the Secretario de Justicia e Instruccion Publica, would be issued within days. Exclude the official circular above and the pedagogical article below.
preparation_note: Direct primary inspection fixes the two editorial paragraphs between official Circular numero 53 and the DE FONDO heading. The redaction endorses the requested statistical information for the Congreso de Instruccion and announces the forthcoming Reglamento under study by the Secretario de Justicia e Instruccion Publica. The official circular and Rebsamen article are excluded.

boundary_definition: Printed p. 17, opening of LA PEDAGOGIA MODERNA across the lower left and upper right columns: fix the heading/subheading and conceptual opening from the definition of Pedagogy as science and art of education through the contiguous examples showing education treated as synonymous with urbanity and with instruction. Stop before the later paragraph on conditions required for educational action.
preparation_note: The earlier scholarly pp. 17-18 pointer is superseded by direct inspection of printed p. 17 in the exact 31 October 1889 HNDM issue. The fixed opening of La Pedagogia Moderna records contemporary uses that equate educacion with urbanidad or instruccion. These semantic distinctions are retained as source-critical evidence and the unit stops before the article moves into conditions for educational action.
